name: demo-theatre-aircraft-track
select: _timestamp, if(match(trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), '^[A-Z0-9 ]+$'), trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), upper(toString(_json.hex))) AS callsign, upper(toString(_json.hex)) AS hex, toString(_json.t) AS type, toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lat)) AS lat, toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lon)) AS lon, toString(_json.alt_baro) AS altitude, toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.gs)) AS speed, toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.track)) AS heading
